question: What crash modification factor for installing an ALL-WAY plaque is listed in Table 2B-1?
model_answer: Direct Answer: The evidence does not support the premise of this question. Table 2B-1 is titled "Regulatory Sign and Plaque Sizes" and lists sign dimensions (e.g., the All Way plaque, R1-3P, at 18 x 6 inches for conventional roads and 30 x 12 inches oversized) — it does not contain crash modification factors. No crash modification factor for installing an ALL-WAY plaque appears anywhere in the provided evidence, so I cannot answer as asked. Standards (mandatory): - For context on when the plaque is required: "At intersections where all approaches are controlled by STOP signs (see Section 2B.12), an ALL-WAY (R1-3P) supplemental plaque (see Figure 2B-1) shall be mounted below each STOP sign. The ALL-WAY plaque shall have a white legend and border on a red background." Visual evidence: [Image 5] shows Table 2B-1, "Regulatory Sign and Plaque Sizes," in which the All Way (plaque) R1-3P row lists only sizes (18 x 6 for conventional roads, 30 x 12 oversized) and contains no crash modification factor column.
